stories.title: Days after resigning over affair, Jensen Huang ‘talks’ return as Nvidia CEO; ‘Everyone loves Jensen’ call
stories.summary: There are discussions about Jensen Huang potentially returning as Nvidia CEO, days after he resigned due to an affair. The sentiment among many is that people want him back in the leadership role.

stories.title: ULA Rocket Carrying 40 Amazon Satellites Fails: What Went Wrong In Space?
stories.summary: A ULA Vulcan rocket failed to place 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites into orbit due to an anomaly shortly after launch. This incident raises questions about the Blue Origin BE-4 engines and could impact Amazon's satellite internet initiatives.

stories.title: How Sam Bankman-Fried Lost Out on a $35 Billion Jackpot From Anthropic
stories.summary: The founder of the defunct FTX crypto exchange, currently imprisoned for fraud, missed out on a significant financial gain. An investment of $500 million in Anthropic would have resulted in a substantial profit.

stories.title: UpGrad launches advisory arm 'upGrad Next' to help enterprises navigate AI-led transformation
stories.summary: UpGrad has introduced a new advisory division called 'upGrad Next.' This new arm aims to assist businesses in managing their transition to AI-driven operations.

stories.title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo India Launch Teased: Expected Price, Specifications And Features
stories.summary: Motorola has hinted at the upcoming launch of the Edge 70 Neo in India, with a microsite on Flipkart revealing some design and camera details. Information regarding its expected specifications and estimated price in India is available.

stories.title: Is Jensen Huang Plotting a Comeback?
stories.summary: There is a discussion in Silicon Valley about whether Jensen Huang should return as Nvidia's leader. While some prominent figures support his return, certain individuals within the Trump administration are against it.

stories.title: Wall Street’s former top regulator says we’re in an AI bubble that could burst by 2028 election
stories.summary: A former top regulator on Wall Street believes that the current situation with artificial intelligence is an economic bubble. This individual predicts that this bubble could potentially burst by the time of the 2028 election.

stories.title: India joins US-led alliance to secure AI supply chains amid China tech rivalry
stories.summary: India has joined a US-led alliance of ten nations to secure artificial intelligence supply chains, aiming to protect sensitive technologies and address competition from China. This initiative involves creating working groups to foster cooperation in AI policy and security, building on previous efforts to safeguard critical resources.

stories.title: Market Bulls Back In Action: Sensex Jumps 510 Points, Nifty Nears 25,300
stories.summary: Indian stock markets saw a significant rise, with the Sensex gaining 510 points and the Nifty approaching 25,300. This rally indicates investor confidence despite global uncertainties, though its continued strength depends on factors such as institutional investments and crude oil prices.

stories.title: Wholesale inflation jumps to 12.29% in October due to rising crude and power prices
stories.summary: Wholesale inflation in India rose to 12.29% in October, primarily due to a sharp increase in fuel and power prices. Crude petroleum and natural gas prices saw a substantial jump, while food articles experienced a minor inflation increase and manufactured goods showed some easing.

stories.title: A Rare Nationwide Ground Stop Brings All US Air Traffic to a Standstill
stories.summary: A rare nationwide ground stop recently halted all air traffic across the United States. This event brought flights to a standstill, impacting travel throughout the country.

stories.title: How Trump is hoping to use an Asia trip to reassert his authority
stories.summary: Donald Trump is reportedly planning to use an upcoming trip to Asia as an opportunity to reassert his authority. The trip is seen as a strategic move to strengthen his position.

stories.title: 'Don't Lecture India': Meloni Ally BLASTS Italian Leader’s 'Vote Thieves' Remark At Congress Event
stories.summary: An ally of Italian leader Giorgia Meloni reportedly criticized her remarks about "vote thieves" made at a Congress event, telling her not to lecture India. This indicates disagreement within political circles regarding her comments.

stories.title: Iran raises stakes with new drone attacks as Trump signals a waiting game
stories.summary: Iran has escalated tensions by launching new drone attacks, while Donald Trump has indicated a strategy of waiting to observe developments. This suggests a period of heightened military activity and a cautious response from the US.

stories.title: Bilkis Bano Case: Supreme Court Suspends Life Sentences Of Two Convicts, Grants Bail
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has suspended the life sentences of two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case and granted them bail. This decision alters the legal status of the individuals involved in the case.

stories.title: US government is proposing one sentence change in USCIS rules that would change every H-1B visa extension
stories.summary: The US government is considering a minor change to USCIS rules that could significantly alter how H-1B visa extensions are processed. This proposed alteration could impact many individuals seeking to prolong their stay in the country under this visa category.

stories.title: US allows 15-day premium processing for H-1B and 26 other employment visa categories | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: The United States has introduced a 15-day premium processing option for H-1B visas and 26 other types of employment-based visas. This new service allows for faster processing of these visa applications.

stories.title: US proposes new review rules for H-1B and other visas
stories.summary: The US government is suggesting new regulations for the review process of H-1B and other types of visas. These proposed changes could affect how these visa applications are evaluated.

stories.title: 'H-1B visas are temporary': US warns more companies of possible action
stories.summary: The US government is reminding companies that H-1B visas are temporary and has issued warnings about potential actions for non-compliance. This indicates a stricter stance on the temporary nature of these visas.

stories.title: International Student Enrollment Down 9% in Fall 2026
stories.summary: Preliminary data indicates that international student enrollment decreased by 9% in Fall 2026. This marks the first time in five years that the number of individuals participating in Optional Practical Training (OPT) has declined.
